Our services

A soft-touch express exterior wash, detailing by appointment, and six covered vacuum bays, all at one stop on Pettingill Road.

Soft-touch express exterior wash

You stay in your car while a conveyor pulls it through the tunnel. Soft brushes do the scrubbing after a pre-soak loosens the dirt, which is what lifts road film that high-pressure water alone leaves behind. Most cars are through in about two minutes, and the 7'2" (2.18 m) entrance clearance fits most cars, SUVs and pickups.

Our tunnel uses up to 90% less water per vehicle than the average driveway wash, and the reclaim system treats the water before it goes back to nature.

What happens in the tunnel

  1. Pre-soak and wheel cleaner break down salt, grime and brake dust.
  2. Soft-touch brushes clean the body, front and back.
  3. Triple shine foam conditions the paint (Better and Best).
  4. Undercarriage rinse with rust inhibitor rinses salt from underneath (Better and Best).
  5. Clear coat protectant adds a protective layer (Better and Best).
  6. Premium protectant and premium wax for extra shine and protection (Best).
  7. Spot-free rinse and drying agent, then the 90 hp dryers.

Wash levels

Good covers the basics. Better adds triple shine foam, an undercarriage rinse with rust inhibitor and clear coat protectant. Best adds premium protectant and premium wax on top.
